message:
I drafted Plan A, but it doesn't meet your Tuesday/Thursday preference. It's a draft only, so nothing is saved or registered.

Plan A (13 credits):
- CS3650 §01 (CRN 91010), Tue/Thu 9:50–11:30
- CS3651 lab §01 (CRN 91020), Fri 9:00–10:40
- ENGW3302 (CRN 91030), Mon/Wed 10:30–11:50. This is your protected section.
- PSYC1101 (CRN 91040), Tue/Thu 3:50–5:30 pm

The tradeoff: CS3650 is required, and the only section that works is the 9:50 am Tue/Thu one. That breaks your no-classes-before-noon preference. These are the other options:
- CS3650 §02 (91011), Tue/Thu 2:00–3:40 pm: it needs lab 91021, Wed 12:00–1:10 pm. That overlaps your Wednesday work shift, which starts at 1:00 pm, by 10 minutes.
- Honors §03 (91012), Tue/Thu noon: you don't meet its MATH2800 prerequisite, so you can't take it.

The plan meets the 12-credit minimum and has no rule errors or conflicts with your work hours. Every other course I included also falls after noon on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

Should I keep Plan A as is, or would you rather I try the §02 option? That one would conflict with your work shift, so I'd only do it if you can shift the Wednesday hours. I won't save or register anything unless you tell me to.
